prompt:
Build the focx.ai marketing root page in apps/site/, replacing the current placeholder redirect (index.html).

What it is: the umbrella landing page for Focx — the first thing visitors see at focx.ai.

Content and design:
- Hero with the Focx brand treatment from the DS-001 cover: eyebrow line (Brand/Eyebrow style), the 'Focx' wordmark treatment (Brand/Hero, The Fox Tail display face), and a short positioning line in UI/Subheading — mirror the cover frame 9:7 as the design reference.
- A clear link/button into /skills/connect (use the Button/Primary component pattern, Medium/Pill).
- Dark treatment is welcome (surface-inverse background with text-inverse) since the cover reads that way — Design role decides from the Figma source.

Constraints:
- Published tokens and existing component patterns only — no raw values, no new visual inventions. The drift gate applies.
- The Fox Tail is not hosted anywhere yet: use the token's font-family with a sensible fallback stack (do not embed or fetch font files from anywhere except the Google Fonts Geist link already in use).
- Keep it a single static page: apps/site/index.html + apps/site/styles.css. The site-compose copy step serves apps/site at the root — do not touch tools/, render.yaml, or the compose map.
- Page must remain fully served at '/' AND keep /skills/connect reachable (relative link, not hardcoded domain).
